key_insight: Faithful synthetic survival data can support consistent Cox model estimates, but valid statistical inference requires additional correction and calibration.
engineering_relevance: TSGSurv supports synthetic time-to-event data generation for biomedical data sharing, clinical trial simulation, and digital twins.
method: Use a two-stage framework to jointly generate observed times and covariates conditional on event status.
Establish distributional convergence rates and conditions for consistent Cox coefficient estimates.
Apply variance correction and distribution calibration to recover valid inference for the original data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive simulations and two real-data applications evaluating the generative and inferential framework.
watch_item: Distributional fidelity alone does not ensure valid inference; theoretical conditions and inferential corrections must be checked.
paper_title: Faithful Generative Modeling for Censored Time-to-Event Data: From Distributional Fidelity to Statistical Inference
